subject: SIGN clause
notes: kb/Work PB493 (landed, wave 20261032). The refuted REPORT SECTION half is fixed: a report entry inherits its IMMEDIATELY enclosing entry's own clause, else what that entry inherited (EnclosingReportItem), so a subordinate group's clause takes precedence for its subtree by construction, the same shape as the data division's InheritSignWalk. Golden 2002/pb493_report_group_sign_inherited: level 1 SIGN TRAILING SEPARATE over a LINE entry with SIGN LEADING SEPARATE prints `-005` on that line and `005-` on the sibling LINE with no clause (GR2), and an elementary entry's own TRAILING clause prints `005-` inside the LEADING line (GR3).
